notes.title: Challenge Mode Update Now Live!
notes.notes: This game is not dead! After downloading the newest update, you zomblings will be able to purchase "Challenge Mode" from the extras menu for only a modest 20 zombie coins. What is Challange Mode? Well, it's a super-difficult game mode in which each player starts with only one cash, ammo, and health, permadeath is enabled, and the enemies all have double health. Also, depending on how well your team does in a game, you will be given a shiny medal that will display on top of the stage thumbnail for everyone to see. Attached is a picture of the new stage. Have fun!
